caseName: Burlington & Missouri River Railroad v. Mills County
caseNameFull: BURLINGTON AND MISSOURI RIVER RAILROAD CO. v. MILLS COUNTY
summary:
ERROR TO THE SUPREME COURT OF THE STATE OF IOWA.

The case is stated in the opinion.
attorneys: Mr. D. Rover for plaintiff in error., Mr. T. Ewing for defendant in error.

opinions.author: Nelson
opinions.text:
Mr. Justice Nelson

delivered the opinion of the court.

This is a writ of error to the Supreme Court of the State of Iowa. The pleadings and proofs present the same questions involved in the case of the same plaintiffs against Fremont County, and must be disposed of in the same way.

The decree of the court below affirmed,.
